title: One rule for unplaceable references, and evidence-aware severity
summary: This change replaces six overlapping reference rules (bare-reference, reference-without-label, reference-without-link, chat-local-reference, undefined-name, undefined-name-at-start) with a single `unplaceable-reference` rule backed by a new candidate engine in `crates/osf/src/lints/writing/reference.rs`. The engine finds numbers, phrases, times and names in a paragraph, then decides whether the paragraph itself places each one (a link, a bracketed description, a repository name, a file name, a known name, a definer sentence, an absolute date). It also introduces `Evidence` on a finding: a statistical guess (a weak-evidence name, a quoted term, a developer tool) always resolves to a warning that only advises, in every context, so a reply is never refused on a guess. A 94-fixture precision/recall harness and end-to-end hook/commit tests pin the behaviour.

nodes.label: Stop hook
nodes.subtitle: hook stop
nodes.summary: Reads the last assistant message and decides whether to refuse the reply. Now passes each finding's evidence into resolution, so a weak-evidence name alone no longer refuses.

nodes.label: Commit-message check
nodes.subtitle: lint writing --context commit
nodes.summary: Lints a commit message file. The new rule runs here in commit context, where a relative time is a finding.

nodes.label: Prompt hook
nodes.subtitle: hook prompt
nodes.summary: Prints the reminder shown on every prompt. It must never name a retired rule id.

nodes.label: Scan resolution
nodes.subtitle: scan::resolve_and_explain
nodes.summary: Resolves scan findings and appends the explain hint. Now forwards the finding's evidence to the shared resolver.

nodes.label: lint_writing
nodes.subtitle: writing::lint_writing
nodes.summary: Runs every writing rule over a document and then applies context. Now calls the new unplaceable_reference rule and passes evidence through apply_context.

nodes.label: apply_context
nodes.subtitle: writing::apply_context
nodes.summary: Sets each finding's level and remediation from its rule meta. The new rule uses the finding's own evidence; older rules keep deterministic evidence until they are retired.

nodes.label: unplaceable_reference
nodes.subtitle: rules::unplaceable_reference
nodes.summary: Collects candidates per paragraph, keeps the first use of each name, picks one paragraph to report a repeated name from, and emits a finding for every candidate the paragraph does not place.

nodes.label: Placement checks
nodes.subtitle: is_placed and friends
nodes.summary: Decides whether a paragraph places a candidate: links, bracketed or colon descriptions, appositives, repository names, file names and paths, known names, definer sentences, absolute dates, and tool descriptions.

nodes.label: Candidate engine
nodes.subtitle: writing::reference
nodes.summary: Finds number, phrase, time and name candidates in a paragraph, masks quoted and backticked spans, and keeps the longest candidate per kind.

nodes.label: Name evidence
nodes.subtitle: looks_like_a_name, candidate_names
nodes.summary: The weak-evidence test for a capitalised run: an inner capital, a digit, a domain suffix, or a repeated multi-word run. Now shared with the candidate engine.

nodes.label: Known names
nodes.subtitle: writing::names
nodes.summary: The built-in name list, extended with frameworks, design systems and model tiers, plus a new is_generic_word helper so a generic label word never counts as a name.

nodes.label: Rule metadata
nodes.subtitle: writing::meta
nodes.summary: The rule table. Adds the unplaceable-reference entry and threads evidence through RuleMeta::resolve.

nodes.label: resolve
nodes.subtitle: osf_lint_core::resolve
nodes.summary: Maps class, group, context, exception and evidence to a level and a remediation. Statistical evidence short-circuits to a warning that only advises, in every context.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.subtitle: Deterministic | Statistical
nodes.summary: A finding's own evidence. Statistical means the rule guessed, so the finding may advise but never block.

nodes.label: Unplaceable fixtures
nodes.subtitle: tests/fixtures/writing/unplaceable
nodes.summary: 94 markdown fixtures, each with an osf-unplaceable header naming its label, kind, target and reason. They cover numbers, phrases, times, names and model-only cases.

nodes.label: Precision/recall measure
nodes.subtitle: unplaceable_measure.rs
nodes.summary: Runs the lint over every fixture and asserts perfect precision and recall per kind and in total, with no stray finding away from its target.

nodes.label: End-to-end checkpoints
nodes.subtitle: unplaceable_checkpoints.rs
nodes.summary: Drives the compiled binary: a bare fix number refuses the stop, a quoted example does not, a relative time passes in a reply but fails a commit message, and the prompt names no retired rule id.

flows.title: A reply is checked for unplaceable references
flows.summary: The stop hook reads the last assistant message, the writing lint finds candidates, decides which the paragraph places, and resolves each finding's severity from its evidence.
